subject: Priority seat hold flow for Oct 28 webinar: copy + tracking
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: events@eventplatform.com
Date: 2026-10-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Priority seat hold flow for Oct 28 webinar: copy + tracking

Hi team,

Drafting the inbound RSVP journey for the Oct 28 webinar ("Optimize LLM Inference: Production Cost & Latency Strategies") — want to lock down a priority seat-hold variant we can send to top accounts (enterprise, active evals) that reserves a seat for 48 hours with a single-click RSVP. Goals: reduce friction for high-value prospects and capture intent data in HubSpot.

Key asks:
- Copy check: short subject + 1-line urgency + CTA for seat hold. Draft subject and 2 variant body copies attached.
- Target list: attached CSV (priority segment). Confirm top-100 list and any manual inclusions.
- Tracking: one-time RSVPs should map to unique tracking tokens (sheet attached). Need Ben to confirm link generation approach and fallback for duplicates.
- Reminders: cadence proposed is 24h and 2h reminders for holds; normal RSVP flow uses 72h and 24h.

Draft subject (variant A): "Priority seat held for you — LLM inference webinar, Oct 28"
Variant B (short): "Your seat is on hold: Oct 28 — Confirm in 2 clicks"

Draft email (short):
Hi [First],
We’ve reserved a seat for you at our Oct 28 webinar on real-world LLM inference wins. Hold expires in 48 hours — confirm now and we’ll save your spot.
[CTA: Confirm my seat] (unique token link)

Let me know ASAP if we should widen the hold window or change wording. I’ve attached the segment CSV and the tracking mapping.

Attachments: 20261014-priority-segment.csv, 20261014-tracking-map.xlsx

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Events & Field Marketing | Redwood Inference

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Priority seat hold flow for Oct 28 webinar: copy + tracking

Thanks Marissa — great start. A few edits inline and operational asks: 

1) Hold window: tighten to 24 hours for the top-50 strategic accounts, 48 hours for the rest of the priority segment. We want fast closes on opportunity motion.
2) Subject: go with short variant B for top accounts (higher open rates) and variant A for the remainder.
3) Copy tweak: add a parenthetical note about a limited post-webinar 1:1 slot for strategic accounts — subtle CTA to drive follow-up requests. Example line: "Confirm and request a 1:1 with our solutions team (limited)"
4) Compliance/ops: ensure we log the token->contact mapping to HubSpot property "webinar_priority_token" so CS can follow up. Ben — can you confirm webhook payload fields?

I updated the tracking sheet with the top-50 flag and highlighted the accounts I want auto-escalated to AE follow-up. See attached updated CSV.

On the external vendor note: if events@eventplatform.com can produce single-use tokens we’re good; if not, we’ll need a short-lived redirect that logs and expires tokens.

Thanks — please ack and I’ll approve copy for send.

Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Head of Demand Gen | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Priority seat hold flow for Oct 28 webinar: copy + tracking

Ack — technical notes and what I updated: 

- Tokens: I can generate single-use tokens with a 24h TTL in our event service. Generated link pattern: https://redwoodinference.app/rsvp/t/{token} which will call the webhook to mark the token consumed and write contact + token to HubSpot (property: webinar_priority_token).
- Webhook payload: {contact_email, contact_id, token, event_id, token_ttl, priority_flag}. I added these headers to the tracking sheet.
- Duplicates: if a token link is opened after consumption we redirect to the RSVP confirmation page with a message "Your seat is already confirmed" and present the standard RSVP CTA to register an additional seat if needed.
- Tracking map: attached 20261014-tracking-map.xlsx with columns: token, prospect_id, priority_bucket, hubspot_id, sent_campaign_id. I filled in the top-50 bucket per Maya’s highlights.
- Reminders: implement two flows — Seat-hold reminders (24h and 2h) only for the priority segment, standard reminders (72h, 24h) for others.

I attached the tracking map. No gating from infra — vendor token generation preferred but we can host if required.

Ben
Ben Carter
Marketing Ops Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: 20261014-tracking-map.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Gomez <alice@acmeai.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Priority seat hold flow for Oct 28 webinar: copy + tracking

Hi Alice — great question and welcome.

Short answers:
- 1:1 requests: when a priority contact confirms we surface a checkbox "Request 1:1 with solutions team" on the confirmation page. If selected, the contact is auto-flagged (webinar_priority_token + 1to1_requested) and routed to AE/solutions queue; AE will reach out to schedule a slot the following week. I flagged AcmeAI as top-50 so you’ll get priority handling.
- Calendar invite: confirmation triggers an immediate ICS we send to the confirmed email address and we include a direct calendar link for easy rescheduling.

Operationally: Ben has generated the tokens and the tracking sheet is finalized. Maya approved copy variants. We’re scheduled to send the priority hold wave on Oct 22 at 10:00 PT to avoid overlap with a large product update email. Standard RSVP wave goes Oct 23.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Events & Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced earlier: 20261014-priority-segment.csv, 20261014-tracking-map.xlsx
